input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: perf: speed up the ai-bookkeeper suite's slowest test (keyword-rule regex scan in suggest)

doc_friction.issue: /usr/bin/time is not installed in the container; a timing loop using it failed once (date +%s%N works).

deviations.why: Both perf backlog items (P063, P064) are owner-gated CODEOWNERS paths; skipped a fresh ci_profile pool reading (one earlier today, docs/history/ci-perf-2026-11-16-stale-lr-memo.md, already ranked the venture-test step and checkout as the top consumers) and went straight to step 3, the slowest venture suite with fewer passes.
deviations.did: Profiled ai-bookkeeper per test file and fixed the top self-time entry.
deviations.result: Suite 33.0/35.3 s to 29.4/29.6 s, identical answers.

notes: Metric: wall time of ai-bookkeeper tests, this container (4 cores). import-order-property.test.mjs via `node --test`, three runs each: before 3.68/3.64/3.88 s, after 1.90/1.99/1.85 s. Whole suite `run_venture_tests.py ai-bookkeeper`, alternating after/before twice: before 33.0/35.3 s, after 29.4/29.6 s; 3,273 tests pass, 1 skipped (no tesseract). Equivalence: old vs new suggest on 8,384 calls (1,048 fixture descriptions x direction x chart filter x classifier), 0 differences. Profile: node --cpu-prof, suggest self 0.78 s of 3.95 s before. Rejected: a union regex of all 499 rules, 15-40x slower per test. Local CI: run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes, 7/7 selected workflows passed (ventures-tests, pages, portfolio-pages, doc-refs, conflict-markers, control-plane-guard; agent-cross-review has no locally runnable step; deploy jobs not run).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: profile a JS suite, write and verify a memo with an equivalence harness, write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
